text_en: A prayer of one afflicted, when faint and pleading before the Lord .
text_cn: 受压迫者在忧心悲愁时，向上主诉苦诉怨的祈祷。

text_en: Hear my prayer, O Lord ; let my cry come to you.
text_cn: 上主，求你允我的祈求， 愿我的呼声上达于你！

text_en: Do not hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Incline your ear to me; answer me speedily in the day when I call.
text_cn: 在我蒙难的时日，求你不要掩面回避我， 我呼号你时，求你侧耳听我，迅速俯允我。

text_en: For my days pass away like smoke, and my bones burn like a furnace.
text_cn: 因为我的日月消散如云烟， 我的骨骸枯焦如火煎。

text_en: My heart is stricken and withered like grass; I am too wasted to eat my bread.
text_cn: 我的心憔悴得像枯草一般， 因此我也忘记了吃我的饭。

text_en: Because of my loud groaning my bones cling to my skin.
text_cn: 因为我哀伤得过度， 我已仅是皮包骨头。

text_en: I am like an owl of the wilderness, like a little owl of the waste places.
text_cn: 我好像成了旷野中的淘河， 我又像成了废墟中的鸱鸮（chī xiāo）；

text_en: I lie awake; I am like a lonely bird on the housetop.
text_cn: 整夜不眠，独自哀号， 像屋顶的孤零小鸟。

text_en: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who deride me use my name for a curse.
text_cn: 我的仇敌常不停地辱骂我， 对我猖狂的人，指名诅咒我；

text_en: For I eat ashes like bread, and mingle tears with my drink,
text_cn: 我吃灰尘当食粮， 我喝涕泪当水汤；

text_en: because of your indignation and anger; for you have lifted me up and thrown me aside.
text_cn: 为了你的义愤与震怒， 你把我举起，将我抛去。

text_en: My days are like an evening shadow; I wither away like grass.
text_cn: 我的日月像倾斜的阴影， 我的本身好像禾草枯零。

text_en: But you, O Lord , are enthroned forever; your name endures to all generations.
text_cn: 然而上主，你却永远常在， 你的名万世万代也不衰。

text_en: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to favor it; the appointed time has come.
text_cn: 求你起来，愿你宽赦熙雍， 因怜悯她的时日已来临。

text_en: For your servants hold its stones dear, and have pity on its dust.
text_cn: 因你的众仆爱惜她的石头， 他们也念念不忘她的废墟。

text_en: The nations will fear the name of the Lord , and all the kings of the earth your glory.
text_cn: 上主，万民必敬畏你的圣名， 普世列王必敬畏你的光荣。

text_en: For the Lord will build up Zion; he will appear in his glory.
text_cn: 因为上主必定要重建熙雍， 且要显现于自己的光荣中。

text_en: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and will not despise their prayer.
text_cn: 他必垂顾穷苦人的祈祷， 也决不拒绝他们的哀号。

text_en: Let this be recorded for a generation to come, so that a people yet unborn may praise the Lord :
text_cn: 应将此写出流传给后世， 叫新生的人民赞美上主。

text_en: that he looked down from his holy height, from heaven the Lord looked at the earth,
text_cn: 因上主由至高圣所俯视， 由高天之上垂顾人世间，

text_en: to hear the groans of the prisoners, to set free those who were doomed to die;
text_cn: 为倾听俘虏的哀叹， 为释放待毙的囚犯，

text_en: so that the name of the Lord may be declared in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,
text_cn: 为在熙雍传述上主的圣名， 在耶路撒冷宣扬他的光荣。

text_en: when peoples gather together, and kingdoms, to worship the Lord .
text_cn: 那时万民都要聚集在一处， 诸邦列国也要来朝拜上主。

text_en: He has broken my strength in midcourse; he has shortened my days.
text_cn: 他在中途将我的力量消减， 将我的岁月缩短；

text_en: “O my God, ” I say, “do not take me away at the midpoint of my life, you whose years endure throughout all generations. ”
text_cn: 我说：我天主，莫让我中年夭折， 但愿你的岁月永留万世万代。

text_en: Long ago you laid the foundation of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
text_cn: 在起初你奠定了下地， 上天也是你手的功绩。

text_en: They will perish, but you endure; they will all wear out like a garment. You change them like clothing, and they pass away;
text_cn: 天地必要毁灭，而你永远存在， 万物必要如同衣裳一样衰败， 有如衣服更换，都要新陈代谢；

text_en: but you are the same, and your years have no end.
text_cn: 但是你却永存不变，你的寿命无尽无限。

text_en: The children of your servants shall live secure; their offspring shall be established in your presence.
text_cn: 愿你仆人的子女居家安康， 愿他们的子孙在你前永昌。
